# Leaf Genix Lifesciences
> Leaf Genix Lifesciences is a Jaipur-based Indian nutraceutical company focused on research-led formulations, complete ingredient quantities and clear product information.

## Primary pages
- [Home](https://leafgenix.in/): Brand overview, formulation standards and featured nutraceuticals.
- [Nutraceutical range](https://leafgenix.in/products): All consumer nutraceutical products, prices, pack sizes and categories.
- [About Leaf Genix](https://leafgenix.in/about): Company identity, standards, manufacturing and regulatory information.
- [Health and nutrition journal](https://leafgenix.in/blog): Evidence-led educational articles with cited sources.
- [Prescription range](https://leafgenix.in/prescription-range): Prescription products listed for healthcare-professional reference only; they are not sold online.
- [Contact](https://leafgenix.in/contact): Official address, telephone, email and enquiry form.
